question: IFEval long context instruction following decay rate empirical study

sources.title: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
sources.snippet: To overcome these issues, we introduce Instruction-Following Eval (IFEval) for large language models. IFEval is a straightforward and easy-to-reproduce evaluation benchmark. It focuses on a set of "verifiable instructions" such as "write in more than 400 words" and "mention the keyword of AI at least 3 times".
